title: The Mysterious Assassin
front_description: In the sleazy nightclub, quick thinking and expert teanmork enable the Jedi to get the drop on Zam.They carry the injured bounty hunter out of the place and demand to know who hired her. But before the shape-shifting Zam can reveal this information, she is fatally hit by a toxic dart. Obi-Wan and Anakin turn to see her assassin, an armored rocket-man, taking off from a nearby roof.
back_description: Doug Chang's design of Jango Fett in his "Rocket Man" armor.
